authoring.prompt:
Rename the parcel pricing helper rate_band to weight_tier in main.isk.
Preserve all other bytes and behavior. Submit main.isk and callers.json
(a JSON array of distinct direct caller names in declaration order).
Public boolean tests: verify_small, verify_pair, verify_cover, verify_bulk.
Both groups also have ["grep",literal] (all matching numbered lines),
["lines",first,last] (inclusive 1-based), ["write",source] (ordinary whole-file
edit), ["test",root,...] (isk test).
Use JSON arrays of actions, executed left to right. Operations:
["read"] returns main.isk. ["replace",before,after] replaces one unique literal
substring; use context for repeated text. ["callers",["name",...]] writes callers.json.
["check"] and ["run"] invoke the ISK CLI. ["submit"] freezes your current files
for grading; one correction is allowed if rejected. Submit must end the batch.
